name: TryHackMe
description: Gamified cybersecurity training platform with 8+ million registered learners. Beginner-friendly approach providing structured skill validation from entry-level to advanced.

peerReview.processDescription: Structured learning paths designed by security professionals. Each training room undergoes content review for accuracy and pedagogical quality. Community validation through user reviews. ISO 27001 compliant certifications.

attribution.attributionNotes: TryHackMe certifications recognized in the industry. Platform rankings provide measurable skill progression.

povsAlignment.description: Tool development / benchmarking through gamified training with structured learning paths.
